name: VideoText

requirements: The text is ordinary text in the page from the server render, readable with no JavaScript, and read once by screen readers
Decoration only: the animated layers are hidden from assistive technology and never take focus
Stands still for visitors who ask for less motion (prefers-reduced-motion), and can also be shown still with the rdm-still class or isPaused
In forced-colors (high contrast) mode the text is drawn in the system colours with no effect
Does not flash: nothing changes more than three times in a second (WCAG 2.3.1)
Optional: it is a separate component, so projects that do not add it carry none of its code
No video is included: you supply src. The video is muted, plays inline, loops and is hidden from assistive technology
Until the video has loaded, and whenever it is paused, stopped by reduced motion or unavailable, the letters show the fallback gradient
A video behind letters has no guaranteed contrast: keep the text large and bold, and do not use it for text people must read to act
Decorative video needs no captions; if the video carries meaning, give that meaning in nearby text
screenReader: Read as ordinary text: the effect is purely visual

description: Large text that shows a video you supply through its letters. The text stays real text; a gradient fallback shows until the video plays.

src.description: URL of the video you supply. Without it the fallback gradient is shown.

poster.description: URL of a poster image for the video.

fallback.description: CSS background shown through the letters until the video plays, or instead of it.

tone.description: The surface the video box sits on: light draws a white box, dark a black one.

isPaused.description: Pauses the video and shows the fallback gradient instead. Moving content that lasts more than five seconds should be stoppable.

use_when: A large hero word over a short looping video
avoid_when: Text people must read to act
Slow connections where the video is large
anti_patterns: Long videos with fast cuts or flashing
